CheckTitle: Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse of the last 24 passwords
Description: The IAM account password policy must prevent reuse of the last 24 passwords. Password reuse prevention stops users from cycling back to previously compromised passwords after forced resets.
Risk: Without reuse prevention, users may cycle through a small set of passwords, making previously leaked credentials effective again. If an old password was exfiltrated, reuse allows attackers to regain access after a password change.
Remediation: Update the IAM account password policy to prevent reuse of the last 24 passwords via the AWS Management Console or CLI: aws iam update-account-password-policy --password-reuse-prevention 24.
SeverityBasis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0 Control 1.9 (Level 1); NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 IA-5(1) — prohibiting known-compromised password reuse
AuthoritativeSource: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0; NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5
